about.title: About IF Builder
about.p1: Create branches, objects, and define the interactions that advance your interactive fiction.
about.p2: All interactive fictions created here are exported in a .zip file. It doesn't need internet or the editor to work - just a browser. Think of this file like a USB flash drive: you can keep it in a drawer, or give it to someone.

about.title: About IF Builder
about.subtitle: Learn the mission and values behind IF Builder.

project.p1: IF Builder is an interactive fiction editor - textual narratives where the player decides what happens next.
project.p2: Here, interactive fictions are written in branches. It's easy to visualize where each choice takes the player and how paths cross. If you want something to happen only if the player has a specific item or made a previous choice, the editor easily handles that.
project.p3: When finished, the editor exports a .zip file that works in any browser. Your story leaves the editor and goes straight to whoever wants to play. And if that person uses IF Builder, they can import the .zip file into the editor and see how you created your story. Maybe even make a remix?

versions.devlogContent:
🚀 Atualizações e Melhorias da Versão v0.10.6

• Correção Multimídia e Estabilidade do AppImage no Linux:
  - Habilitação da flag nativa bundleMediaFramework no Tauri, garantindo que o plugin de áudio autoaudiosink (gst-plugins-good) e todas as dependências multimídia sejam empacotadas no .AppImage.
  - Varredura dinâmica de diretórios e scanner de plugins do GStreamer no inicializador Rust, prevenindo travamentos (SIGABRT no MediaPlayerPrivateGStreamer) ao abrir o aplicativo ou iniciar demos.
  - Atualização do CI no GitHub Actions com suporte completo a headers e plugins de áudio (incluindo pipewire e plugins-good-dev).

• Camada de Efeitos Visuais (Overlays) nos Capítulos e Abertura:
  - Reestruturação do empilhamento de camadas (z-index) para que efeitos como chuva, névoa, granulação, glitch, tv e outros ocorram estritamente sobre o painel de imagem/fundo.
  - Textos narrativos, títulos e botões de interação (incluindo o botão "COMEÇAR" da vinheta de abertura) permanecem sempre em primeiro plano, garantindo máxima legibilidade.

• Transições por Interação e Controles Visuais:
  - Suporte a transições personalizadas por interação (Fade, Slide, Zoom, etc.) com controle dedicado de tempo e velocidade.
  - Ajuste de cores e contraste nos estados inativos do tema "Menta", comunicando com clareza botões desabilitados (como o botão de Pré-visualizar sem projeto).
  - Ajustes de layout e espaçamento na barra lateral (Sidebar) para exibição sem truncamento.

• Testes e Confiabilidade:
  - Cobertura de testes unitários expandida com 100% de sucesso na suíte do Vitest (33/33 testes aprovados).

welcome.description: This is a tool for authors to create interactive fictions without hassle. Create branching narratives, control possible actions, and compile entire stories into a file.
welcome.bullet1Desc: Track the structure of your project graphically through the branch map.
welcome.bullet2Desc: Add numerical trackers like health, energy, or sanity to shape the consequences of choices.
welcome.bullet3Desc: Offer your players traditional action buttons or the freedom of a text interpreter (parser).
welcome.bullet4Desc: Generate .zip files independent of internet or servers. Just extract and play directly in the browser.

guide.title: Quick Guide
guide.intro: IF Builder makes crafting interactive fiction intuitive and flexible. A story is structured using Branches, Scenarios & Views, and Chapters, where players read rich descriptions, observe illustrations, explore interactive details, and make choices using buttons or natural language commands.

scenes.title: 1. Branches
scenes.desc: Branches are textual narrative nodes where the story unfolds and paths diverge based on player decisions.
scenes.item1: Title and Description: The main narrative text and atmosphere the player reads upon reaching this point in the story.
scenes.item2: Interactive Text: Wrap words in < > to make them clickable (e.g. <door> or <chest>). Clicking executes the action automatically.
scenes.item3: Illustration and Soundtrack: Each branch can have its own background artwork and exclusive music.
scenes.item4: Starting Point and Endings: Define which node begins the adventure and mark conclusive branches as narrative endings.
scenes.exampleHtml: You approach a locked iron <chest>.
scenes.exampleTip: Clicking the highlighted word triggers the action directly.

scenarios.title: 2. Scenarios and Views
scenarios.desc: Rich visual environments composed of multiple views (camera perspectives) where players explore artwork and click directly on Interactive Areas drawn over the scene.
scenarios.item1: Scene Views: Different angles and visual perspectives of the same room with their own artwork.
scenarios.item2: Interactive Areas: Regions drawn directly over the illustration that react to clicks with visual and audio feedback.
scenarios.item3: Click Actions: Each area can switch views, navigate to another scene, open an examine dialogue, collect an item, or update trackers.
scenarios.item4: Keys and Requirements: Lock passages or chests requiring items in the inventory before interacting.

chapters.title: 3. Chapters
chapters.desc: Full-screen cinematic scenes that mark dramatic transitions, time passages, title openings, and major story conclusions.
chapters.item1: Opening Chapter: Title screen with game introduction and start button (e.g. 'Begin Adventure').
chapters.item2: Transition Chapters: Linear narrative bridges for journeys, act transitions, or dramatic reveals with a continue button.
chapters.item3: Conclusion Chapters: Story conclusions celebrating a Victory or presenting a Defeat ending.
chapters.cardOpeningDesc: Title screen and introduction before the story starts.
chapters.cardTransitionDesc: Passage between acts, travels, and narrative bridges.
chapters.cardConclusionDesc: Victory, defeat, and conclusive story endings.

objects.title: 4. Object Library
objects.desc: Items and world elements that can be examined in detail, collected into inventory, and used to solve puzzles.
objects.item1: Name & Recognition: The item name recognized by both clicks and the command parser (e.g. 'Bronze Key').
objects.item2: Examine Description: Detailed text describing the object when closely inspected.
objects.item3: Optional Artwork: Artwork displayed when examining the item from the backpack.
objects.item4: Collectible: Defines whether the object can be gathered into the player's inventory.
objects.exampleDesc: A wooden torch with flickering flames lighting the dark corridors.

interactions.title: 5. Interactions and Commands
interactions.desc: Defines what occurs when the player types a natural language command or clicks an action.
interactions.item1: Verbs: Trigger words for the action (e.g. open, use, unlock, push).
interactions.item2: Target: The scene object affected by the action (e.g. Door).
interactions.item3: Requirement: Mandatory item in inventory for the action to succeed (e.g. Key).
interactions.item4: Result: Navigate to branch, display success text, play sound effect, or trigger a chapter.
interactions.tip: The command parser recognizes natural variations such as "Use key on door".

globals.title: 6. Global Verbs
globals.desc: Universal utility commands available at any point throughout the adventure.
globals.item1: Universal Commands: Words such as help, look, and inventory.
globals.item2: Standard Responses: Informative feedback providing player guidance without altering the current scene.
globals.descHelp: Displays general instructions and gameplay tips
globals.descInventory: Opens the list of carried items

mechanics.title: 7. Mechanics
mechanics.desc: Optional rules and interactive systems that enrich the experience and narrative structure.
mechanics.item1: Input Modes: Choose between Command Parser (free text typing) or Choice Mode (clickable buttons).
mechanics.item2: Lives / Chances System: Mistake counter that triggers a defeat conclusion when exhausted.
mechanics.item3: Adventure Logbook: Automatic record of clues, dialogues, and story discoveries.
mechanics.item4: Dice Rolling (D6 / D20): Skill and luck checks with immediate Success or Failure outcomes.
mechanics.item5: Audio & Music: Continuous ambient background music and synchronized sound effects.
mechanics.systemsSummary: Systems: Lives (Chances), Logbook, Dice D6/D20, and Music

trackers.title: 8. Consequence Trackers
trackers.desc: Numeric meters to monitor values like Health, Sanity, Currency, Energy, or Time.
trackers.item1: Numeric Scale: Define starting value and maximum scale (e.g. 100/100).
trackers.item2: Threshold & Consequence: Directs the player to a specific Chapter when the value hits the limit.
trackers.item3: Action Impact: Interactions, choices, and interactive areas can add or deduct tracker points.

appearance.title: 9. Visual Style and Themes
appearance.desc: Customize the visual aesthetic of your story with curated color palettes, typography, frames, and real-time screen effects.
appearance.item1: Predefined Themes: Instant curated palettes: Midnight, Parchment, Retro Terminal, Amber, Windows 95, Noir, Vampire, and Cyberpunk.
appearance.item2: Colors & Typography: Customize background, text, titles, highlights, and serif, modern sans, or monospace fonts.
appearance.item3: Layout & Frames: Vertical or Horizontal orientation and image frames (Clean, Rounded, Vignette fade, and Glassmorphism).
appearance.item4: Screen Effects: Dynamic atmospheric layers like Rain, Snow, Dust/Particles, CRT Scanlines, Film Grain, and Retro Dither.
appearance.effectsList: 🌧️ Rain • ❄️ Snow • 📺 CRT Scanlines • 🎬 Film Grain

labels.title: 10. Labels and System Texts
labels.desc: Adapt system messages, buttons, and instructions to match the tone of voice and atmosphere of your narrative.
labels.item1: Navigation Buttons: Titles for Save, Load, Restart, Retrospective, Menu, and Start.
labels.item2: Command Input Bar: Prompt placeholder text (e.g. 'What do you do next?').
labels.item3: Feedback Responses: Atmospheric feedback for unknown commands, empty inventory, and dice roll results.
labels.row1Default: What do you want to do?
labels.row2Custom: The castle silence offers no answer.

map.title: 11. Connections Map
map.desc: Panoramic visual overview of the entire story structure, showing connections between branches, scenarios, and chapters.
map.item1: Story Flow Overview: Inspect narrative branches, decision paths, and story branches in a single graphic canvas.
map.item2: Instant Navigation: Double-click any node to jump directly into editing it.
map.item3: Spatial Organization: Drag and organize nodes to arrange acts, chapters, and timelines.
map.tip: Use the map to spot orphan nodes or dead ends.

preview.title: 12. Preview and Testing
preview.desc: Embedded simulator to test the story interactively as a real player.
preview.item1: Instant Testing: Open the preview anytime without exporting files.
preview.item2: Flexible Starting Point: Start testing from the beginning or directly from your active working scene.
preview.item3: Puzzle Verification: Validate commands, clickable areas, inventory, and trackers before sharing.
preview.check1: Test all choices and branching paths
preview.check2: Verify that all keys, inventory, and puzzles work

export.title: 13. Saving, Loading and Exporting
export.desc: Generate the distribution package for your interactive fiction ready to run in any browser or publish online.
export.warning: IMPORTANT: IF Builder runs locally in your browser and does not store cloud data. Always save your .zip project file to keep your progress safe!
export.item1: Export .ZIP: Downloads a complete package with optimized images, sounds, and an index.html ready to play or upload to itch.io.
export.item2: Export Standalone HTML: Single self-contained file with all resources embedded for quick sharing.
export.item3: Load Project: Use the Load button and select your .zip file to resume editing right where you left off.
export.cardZipDesc: Complete folder with index.html and assets to play and continue editing.
export.cardHtmlDesc: Single self-contained file for quick sharing.

manualModal.title: User Manual
manualModal.subtitle: Learn how to create your interactive adventure
manualModal.intro: The IF Builder allows you to create Interactive Fiction games. The game is composed of Branches, where the player reads descriptions, looks at images, and types verbs to interact with Objects and navigate the world.
manualModal.section1Intro: Each branch is a location or moment in your game. Configure:
manualModal.section1Item1: Interactive Text: Use the <word> syntax in the description. This will make the word clickable in the game.
manualModal.section1Item2: Image and Music: Each branch can have a unique background image and soundtrack.
manualModal.section1Item3: Start Branch: Set which branch will be the starting point.
manualModal.section2Intro: Objects are items that can be in a branch. They are global: you create an object once and can link it to multiple branches.
manualModal.section2Item1: Examine: Define a detailed description that the player will see.
manualModal.section3Intro: Interactions define what happens when the player types a verb.
manualModal.verbsDesc: List of words that trigger the action (e.g., open, unlock, use).
manualModal.targetDesc: The object in the branch the player wants to interact with (e.g., Door).
manualModal.reqDesc: The item the player MUST have in their inventory (e.g., Key).
manualModal.resDesc: What happens after the verb (e.g., go to another branch).
manualModal.tip: 💡 Tip: The player can type in any order. The system will automatically identify the keywords.
manualModal.section4Intro: Use trackers to create complex systems like Health, Money, or Stress.
manualModal.section4Item1: Interactions can increase or decrease a tracker's value.
manualModal.section4Item2: When a tracker reaches its maximum value, the player is automatically transported to a Branch of Consequence.
manualModal.section5Item1: Use the Preview button to test the entire experience.
manualModal.section5Item2: Click Export Game to download a .zip file.
manualModal.section5Item3: Extract the zip and open the index.html file in any browser to play or share!
